items.title: DevFest Yola 2026
items.text:
Date: 5 December 2026, 08:00 UTC
Ends: 5 December 2026, 16:00 UTC
Location: TBD, TBD, Yola
Registration: Free registration

Devfest Yola 2026 features immersive, hands-on learning where participants build AI-powered applications, learn from experienced practitioners, and gain practical skills using Google's latest AI tools and technologies.

Attendees experience a full days of inspiring technical talks, expert presentations, community showcases, and networking. Meet fellow developers, industry leaders, startups, and technology partners as we shape the future of the developer ecosystem together.

join us as we explore the future of software development, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, cybersecurity, mobile, web, and emerging technologies through hands-on workshops and expert-led sessions.

Whether you're a beginner, student, experienced developer, founder, or tech professional, DevFest Yola 2026 offers something for everyone.

We look forward to welcoming you to Adamawa's premier community-led developer event.

Register now and be part of the future of technology
